title: Reallocate local slots when a lower-IID peer wins a conflict
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs handle_post_slots detects overlap and rejects the peer when the local IID wins, but when the peer wins it only comments 'handled by caller', stores the peer claim, returns accepted, and leaves info.slot_map unchanged. No outcome or callback tells any caller to reallocate/re-claim, so both gateways continue transmitting in overlapping slots contrary to GCP-6.3's loser MUST select next available slot and re-claim. Implement the local loser transition (or return a mandatory typed action) and test the full conflict/reclaim state change.
close_reason: Implemented: handle_post_slots (rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs:1938) tracks reallocated_slots (:1981), sets the retained local allocation (:2078) when a lower-IID peer wins, and publishes the outcome to callers (:2102); regression lower_iid_peer_forces_complete_local_reallocation (resources.rs:2530) covers the lower-IID conflict path. Slot lib tests green (34 passed).
